ModMetaData.name: Dematerializer
ModMetaData.author: HopeSeekr
ModMetaData.description:
Version 1.1.0 The BetterRimworlds Dematerializer enables you to dematerialize materials and pawns (both friendly and hostile!) from anywhere on the map into a temporary subspace bubble that will persist as long as their is a persistent flow of energy to the subspace capacitors.
**ALERT: The Dematerializer has *harsh* consequences for all higher lifeforms on the map in the case of power failure!**
Latest Changes: * **[2025-03-15 11:45:05 CDT]** Fixed incompatibility with other mods. * **[2025-03-15 11:46:50 CDT]** Added support for Rimworld v1.5. * **[2025-03-15 12:14:12 CDT]** Misc. fixes. * **[2025-03-15 12:18:30 CDT]** Ported to .NET v9.0 and C# v10.0.
